key_terms.الْوَطِيسُ: the furnace or heated ground; idiomatically, the intensity of battle
key_terms.حَمِيَ: became hot or intense; here, it indicates escalation

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith “اَلْآنَ حَمِيَ الْوَطِيسُ” mean?
ai.summary: This concise saying of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم describes the moment when fighting became intense. It is a well-known expression associated with the Day of Hunayn and reflects the severity of battle at that point.
